Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 178 is the target for Bangladesh! They will surely fancy themselves to chase this down, especially after the way they have been batting. India, on the other hand, will need to bowl really well if they are to defend this. They do have a good bowling attack and the wicket is gripping a touch so hitting the right lines and lengths will be very crucial. Can they do so? We will find out.

Shoriful Islam is down for an interview. He says that it felt good bowling with the new ball and he practiced with the new ball in the nets and it worked well today. Adds that the fielding was great and they enjoyed it today.

The Bangladesh players were up for this right from the start! Their new ball bowlers bowled brilliantly, their spinners did well in the end. Even during the middle stages when Varma and Jaiswal looked comfortable, they did not let their body language drop and continued to make scoring hard. They did get rewarded for that as they managed to keep the Indians below 200. Also, their fielding has to be credited too as they were extremely sharp. Diving all around and they made India work for every single run. The catching too was right up there, they hung onto almost everything that came towards them and their effort in the field reflects on the scorecard.

An excellent bowling performance from  Bangladesh comes to an end! Their skipper's decision of bowling first, which is always a big risk in big games has surely turned out to be the right one. They are the favourites to lift the cup as they head back into the dressing room for the break. However, India at one stage looked all set for something around the 240-run mark when Yashashvi Jaiswal was batting. His 94-run stand with Tilak Varma took India into a good position after they lost Saxena early. However, after that stand was broken, India kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Jaiswal too fell at the wrong time, 12 short of a ton and from there the procession started. India slipped from 156 for 3 to 177 all out.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a brilliant catch! Bangladesh have done extremely well to bowl INDIA OUT FOR 177. Length delivery on off, Mishra looks to heave it away but it takes the top edge and goes towards third man. Shoriful Islam runs ahead and dives forward to take the catch. Brilliant stuff from Bangladesh. They have given themselves a very good chance to win the final.

They appeal and the umpire raises his finger. India have lost their nine wickets and they are not even close to reaching 200. Can the last pair get them to that score?

It rolls beside the pitch. Bisnoi wants a run and charges towards the other end. It was his call and it was him who was running towards the danger end. He though had no chance of making it as. Islam gets to the ball, picks it up and then hits the stumps from close range. Can Bangladesh now keep India under 200?

OUT! RUN OUT! Complete confusion out there and Dhruv Jurel has to go after all the drama. There is a big, big mix-up between the two batsmen and the umpire is taking a lot of time to give the decision. Floated ball on off, Jurel defends it to point and takes off for a single. Atharva is not interested and and shouts a loud no to the umpire. Jurel though does not listen and continues on his run. Shamim Hossain throws it to the keeper and whips the bails off. Now, there is a race going on at the non-striker's end. Both Jurel and Ankolekar are trying to make it inside the crease. The on-field umpire takes it upstairs to decide who reached first. From the replays, it looks like Jurel has made it in while Ankolekar's bat was touching the crease. The third umpire thinks otherwise and sends Jurel on his way.  Ravi Bishnoi is the new man in.
Someone is surely out! Who is the question as both the batters were stranded at one end.

Bangladesh have been excellent in the field today and this is another example of it. The 94-run stand is broken and at the right time. The partnership was starting to get a move on. Bangladesh players are ecstatic and they have every right to be.

Also, this partnership between Jaiswal and Varma has started to gain pace and they are rotating the strike a lot better. Bangladesh, on the other hand, have done well so far but they need to keep taking wickets at regular intervals. Can they do so?

First change of the game! Avishek Das is into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Jaiswal lets it go to the keeper.
WIDE! Tanzim bends his back and bowls a bouncer around a middle, Jaiswal ducks under it. Wide signaled. First run of Sakib's bowling.
Good length delivery outside off, Jaiswal pushes it to the point fielder off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Yashasvi taps it to the slip cordon.
Good length delivery outside off, Jaiswal makes another leave to this one.
Fullish outside off, Jaiswal leaves it alone to the keeper.
Full delivery on off, Jaiswal drives it to cover off the front foot.
Good length delivery on off, Saxena punches it to the point fielder. Another good over for Bangladesh.
Good length delivery on off, Divyaansh pushes it to the point fielder.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Jaiswal punches it to point.
BOUNCER! It is bowled around middle, Saxena ducks under it and the umpire calls it a wide.
On a length on the pads, Jaiswal works it to square leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Jaiswal lets it go to the keeper.

Excellent fielding! Full on off, Saxena drives it to cover where the fielder dives to make a good stop. The batters take off for a single. The fielder throws it to the keeper's end and hits but Jaiswal was in.
Another maiden from Hasan Sakib!!! On a length outside off, Yashasvi shoulders arms to it.
Good length delivery outside off, Yashasvi lets it go to the keeper.
Fuller one outside off, Jaiswal makes another leave to this one.
Another good length delivery outside off, Jaiswal has no problems leaving the ball alone to the keeper.
On a length outside off, Jaiswal leaves the ball alone.
An appeal for LBW turned down! Good length delivery on the pads, Jaiswal looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The Bangladesh players appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Full delivery on middle, Saxena pushes it back to the bowler. 3 off the over.
On a length on off, Divyaansh blocks it off the back foot to point.
BOUNCER! WIDE! It is bowled around middle, Saxena ducks under it. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Islam bowls a full delivery outside off, Jaiswal guides it to the third man region for a single.
Fullish outside off, Saxena gets off the mark by driving this to backward point for a single.
Finally, India are underway in the final!!! Back of a length delivery on middle, Jaiswal works it to square leg and crosses over for a single.
BEATEN! Another excellent delivery from Shoriful Islam. Good length delivery outside off, Yashasvi looks to defend off the front foot but fails to get any bat on it.

Two maidens in a row! Full delivery on middle, Saxena pushes it back to the bowler. Tanzim gives another stare at the striker. This final has started on a very aggressive note! Both teams trying to show who the real boss is!
Length ball on off, Divyaansh pushes it to the point fielder.
Last altercation brings out the false shot. That's what Bangladesh have planned. Short ball around off, Saxena looks to play the hook but misses to get any bat on it.

That is some aggression! The bowler and the batsman are going at each other. Full on middle, Saxena drives it back to the bowler. Hasan Sakib has a needless shy at the striker's end and almost takes Divyaansh's head off. They both exchange some heated words but the umpire calms things down.
Fullish delivery on middle, Divyaansh blocks it to mid off for nothing.
Hasan Sakib starts with a length ball on middle, Saxena pushes it to the point fielder off the back foot.
Tanzim Hasan Sakib will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Excellent start from Islam! A maiden. He bowls a good length delivery outside off, Yashasvi leaves it alone for the keeper.
Back of a length ball outside off, Jaiswal shoulders arms to this one.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Jaiswal defends it off the back foot.

Play and a miss! This is lovely bowling from Shoriful Islam. Full delivery outside off, inviting Jaiswal for the drive. Yashasvi obliges and looks to play it to the off side but fails to get any bat on it. Islam is all fired up as he fires in some verbal volleys again.
BEATEN! Beautiful delivery from Islam! This is on a length outside off, Jaiswal looks to defend but misses it. Shoriful gives a stare to Jaiswal who in return smiles.
Islam starts with a full delivery outside off looking for some swing. There is none and Jaiswal drives it to mid off.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems! The final is all set to get underway! The Bangladesh players make their way out to the middle and take their respective positions in the field. Yashasvi Jaiswal and Divyaansh Saxena make their way out as the openers for India. Shoriful Islam will start with the ball for Bangladesh. Two slips waiting...
Both teams make their way out to the middle for their respective National Anthems.

India (Unchanged Playing XI) - Yashasvi Jaiswal, Divyaansh Saxena, Tilak Varma, Priyam Garg (C), Dhruv Jurel (WK), Siddhesh Veer, Atharva Ankolekar, Ravi Bishnoi, Sushant Mishra, Kartik Tyagi, Akash Singh.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Parvez Hossain Emon, Tanzid Hasan, Mahmudul Hasan Joy, Towhid Hridoy, Shahadat Hossain, Akbar Ali (C/WK), Shamim Hossain, Avishek Das (In for Hasan Murad), Tanzim Hasan Sakib, Rakibul Hasan, Shoriful Islam.
Indian skipper, Priyam Garg, says that they have a good middle order batting and they are very confident heading into the final. Informs that they are unchanged.

Bangladesh skipper, Akbar Ali, says that they are bowling first as there was some rain last night and there might be some moisture on the wicket and they are playing with three seamers. Adds that they had the goal to play the final and they are here. Shares that the honorable PM of Bangladesh is very kind and has wished the boys good luck. Informs that they have made one change - Avishek Das comes in for Hasan Murad.
Toss - Up goes the coin, TAILS is the call from Akbar Ali and it has come down as TAILS. BANGLADESH ELECT TO FIELD!

One final time in Africa! The stage is set for the grand finale of the ICC Under-19 World Cup 2020. Two Asian teams after flooring every team coming in their path have reached in Potchefstroom for the title clash. The Boys in Blue will be eyeing their fifth trophy while it's a golden opportunity for Bangladesh to make history. The pressure will be high as the stakes are high and let's wait and find out which team handles it better. Will Priyam Garg join the elite list of Mohammad Kaif, Virat Kohli, Unmukt Chand, and Prithvi Shaw? Or are we going to see the Bangla Cubs roar to take the Asian supremacy? Hello and welcome all for our coverage and stay tuned for more updates...
